description: This file contains the implementation of the Latest products module controller class for the OpenCart platform. It manages fetching and displaying the latest products in a specific extension module context, including image, price, and product data handling.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Latest' products module, extending the core Controller class in OpenCart, responsible for assembling data and rendering the latest products in a module view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for the Latest module controller which prepares product data, including images, prices, and links, then renders the corresponding view.
